bio: Niven Kunz is famous for his 80/20 concept: at Triptyque, vegetables and fruits make up at least 80% of each dish. A true ambassador for Westland, he frequently crosses the region to visit his suppliers. Along with hostess Virginie van Bronckhorst-Kunz, he aims to help you feel at one with nature. They do this subtly, with a certain natural ease. The elegant luxury of the decor also has a natural undertone, with details like dried flowers adding a touch of sophistication.With a highly personal creative approach, the chef puts the terroir in the spotlight. His dishes are defined by their deep, complex flavours. Through a multi-day process, he transforms carrots into a plant-based steak tartare that looks and tastes astonishingly like the real thing.
